boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's wm_etc.c, 0x020634fc..0x02063718: 4 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt, identified by their bodies against pret's pokediamond WM_etc.s, which holds them in the same address order. WM_MeasureChannel was already named. WM_SetLifeTime: WMi_CheckIdle, then callback for API 0x1d and WM_SendCommand(0x1d, 3, ...) (pret's sends four). WM_SetBeaconIndication: WMi_CheckIdle, flag must be 0 or 1 (else 6), API 0x19 with one parameter. WM_SetGameInfo: WM_CheckStateEx(2, 7, 9), a null buffer or a size over 0x70 is 6, the buffer is copied to the game-info buffer and flushed, then API 0x18 (pret's sends five parameters; this one six).

Order: mwccarm emits the bodies in reverse, so the source lists them from WM_SetGameInfo down to WM_MeasureChannel. Older SDK: pret's WM_SetEntry (below WM_MeasureChannel) and WM_SetWEPKeyEx / WM_SetWEPKey (above WM_SetGameInfo) are absent.
BOTTOM EDGE: WM_StartDataSharing (0x020631dc..0x020634fc), the highest function of wm_ds.c (arm9/WM_Ds).
TOP EDGE: func_02063718 at 0x02063718, the WBT library.
notes: Hand-assembled, following arm9/FS_Overlay: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main.
Built as C++, which CP15::FlushDataCache (WM_SetGameInfo) once required; that call is now the SDK's C-linkage DC_StoreRange (nitro/os/cache.h). Every function keeps C linkage.
